reason: I already hand out free meals and services to creators every week and have no idea if any of it brings people in, so a free tool that counts customers per post is worth two minutes of signing up. I'd send the next few creators who DM me through the coupon link and see what the numbers say.
objection: Will good creators actually be on it, or just the same freebie-hunters who already fill my DMs? And will my staff really bother tapping redeem with a PIN on a busy day.
would_change_my_mind: If after a few weeks the only creators showing interest are small accounts with fake-looking views, or my staff skip the redeem step so the counts are useless, I'd stop using it.
